title: Payment → invoice linker

operatingPoint.method: Learn-then-Test conformal risk control (fixed-sequence exact binomial tests) on the calibration split; review threshold = split-conformal 2% quantile of true-link scores, floored at 0.05 to bound reviewer load

sources.name: synthetic
sources.provenance: synthetic — seeded generator (satya_engine.linking.datasets.synthetic); upper bound / regression test only

sources.name: bpi2019
sources.provenance: BPI-2019 derived — real P2P transaction structure from the BPI Challenge 2019 log (van Dongen, 4TU, CC BY 4.0); synthetic Indian identities, numbers, GST/TDS

sources.name: demo
sources.provenance: demo — Satya curated demo dataset (CONSTRUCTED_DEMO), held out from all fitting; sanity check only

data.splitPolicy: group-disjoint by buyer world: train 50% / valid 15% / calib 15% / test 20%; demo held out

limitations: No real customer data: every number here is synthetic, BPI-2019-derived (real structure, synthetic identities) or curated-demo. None of it is a real-company accuracy claim.

The ≥99% auto-link precision guarantee (Learn-then-Test) holds only if deployment data are exchangeable with the calibration data; on a real tenant it must be re-certified on that tenant's reviewed links (shadow mode + audit slice).
Printed references (PO numbers on invoices, invoice numbers in narrations) are simulated at fixed rates; real rates vary by supplier and change performance a lot.
BPI-2019 quantities, rates, GST and TDS are synthesised from real net worth; descriptions are spend-area texts (low diversity).
The demo hold-out is one small curated world (tens of links); its numbers have very wide uncertainty.
Decisions are per from-document (invoice/GRN) and per pair (payment); one invoice billing several POs is not modelled.
intendedUse: Propose evidence links between AP documents that lack explicit references. Auto-zone links are written as PROBABLE (never CONFIRMED) and stay reversible; review-zone links go to a person. Not for payment release decisions on its own; not validated on real company data.
selection: highest validation PR-AUC among deployable models (logistic, XGBoost), calibrated-Brier tie-break; HistGradientBoosting is a non-deployable challenger (no exact per-decision attributions)
